name: pc-control-dashboard
description: Universal PC Remote Controller Startpage and Dashboard

scripts.build: python pack_agent.py && cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && python pack_agent.py && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('./dist/index.html', './index.html'); if (fs.existsSync('./assets')) fs.rmSync('./assets', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('./dist/assets', './assets', {recursive:true});"
